lines.speaker: Nigel
lines.en: Good afternoon.

lines.speaker: Nigel
lines.en: I believe that this house is for sale.
lines.zh: 我想这房子是要出售的吧！

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.en: That's right.

lines.speaker: Nigel
lines.en: May I have a look at it, please?

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.en: Yes, of course.

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.en: Come in.

lines.speaker: Nigel
lines.en: How long have you lived here?
lines.zh: 您在这里住了多长时间？

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.en: I've lived here for twenty years.
lines.zh: 我在这里已经住了 20 年了。

lines.speaker: Nigel
lines.en: Twenty years!

lines.speaker: Nigel
lines.en: That's a long time.

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.en: Yes, I've been here since 1976.
lines.zh: 是啊，从 1976 年起我就住在这里。

lines.speaker: Nigel
lines.en: Then why do you want to sell it?
lines.zh: 那么，您为什么要卖掉它呢？

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.en: Because I've just retired.

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.en: I want to buy a small house in the country.
lines.zh: 我想在乡下买幢小房子。

lines.speaker: Nigel
lines.en: How much does this house cost?

lines.speaker: Nigel
lines.en: That's a lot of money!

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.en: It's worth every penny of it.
lines.zh: 它确确实实值这么多钱。

lines.speaker: Nigel
lines.en: Well, I like the house, but I can't decide yet.
lines.zh: 啊，我喜欢这房子，但我还不能决定。

lines.speaker: Nigel
lines.en: My wife must see it first.
lines.zh: 我妻子必须先来看一看。

lines.speaker: Ian
lines.en: Women always have the last word.
lines.zh: 女人总是最后说了算的。
